source_title: My Hero Academia Creator Horikoshi Officially Unveils Prime Izuku Midoriya
source_excerpt:
My Hero Academia ended its official run in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Double Issue 36-37, on August 5, 2024, with the release of its chapter 430. This chapter marked the end of the Epilogue arc of the series and took us 8 years into the future, where the vast majority of the students from UA's Class 1-A were now Pro Heroes. At the same time, this chapter also confirmed Deku's role as a teacher at UA before finally giving him a new upgrade and making him a Pro Hero as well.
Izuku Midoriya's role as a Pro Hero continued in My Hero Academia Extra Chapter 431, on December 4, 2024, before it was eventually adapted into the anime on May 2, 2026. Now, fans have received a proper look at Pro Hero Izuku Midoriya, alongside his powers straight from the author, Kohei Horikoshi.
Kohei Horikoshi Confirms Deku As No. 4 Hero In His Prime With New Armor
My Hero Academia has received a lot of supplementary content after the conclusion of its anime and manga series, the latest of which was released on August 2, 2026, in the form of a special anime OVA titled “I Am a Hero Too.” This special OVA focused on Eri, but it also gave us brief glimpses of the Pro Heroes from Japan. Most importantly, the Hero Billboard Chart in Japan was updated in this chapter, revealing to us how far Izuku Midoriya had come as a Pro Hero.
"The Number 4 Hero, Deku, rocketed up the Hero Charts with unprecedented hype! Feeling inspired, huh? The Great Explosive Murder God Dynamite is making an impressive leap to No. 5." — Official Hero Rank Announcement for Izuku Midoriya, My Hero Academia One-Shot
This special episode release confirmed that Izuku Midoriya currently stands as Japan's Number 4 Hero and that he has surpassed Bakugo Katsuki in hero rankings as well, who is right behind him in fifth place. Izuku Midoriya's rise to the Number 4 Hero ranking doesn't come as a surprise to any fan. Despite losing the power of One For All in the final battle of My Hero Academia and burning all the remaining embers, Izuku still operates as a Pro Hero right now, much of which is down to the new hero armor that he received. The data collected from All Might Vs All For One, combined with the scientific and technological advancements in the last 8 years, led to the creation of this Hero Armor, funded by the vast majority of Class 1-A and All Might. This hero armor has propelled him to sky-high levels and allows him to be a Pro Hero once again. His Number 4 ranking on the hero billboard chart goes to show that he is actually incredibly powerful right now, even though he does not have One For All.
Why Pro Hero Deku Is The New Strongest Hero
Pro Hero Deku might be very underrated, and this is because he does not have a quirk. The vast majority of us may think of him as weak when compared to those with Quirks, especially reawakened Quirks, such as Bakugo Katsuki or Shoto Todoroki. However, in reality, Deku's Hero Armor is incredibly strong.
"I wanted to give you a special gift. The data from my fight against All For One opened up room for crazy possibilities. Technology has continued to evolve alongside Quirks. Take this to heart, kid. This too is a power you've earned, fair and square." — All Might gives Deku his Armor, My Hero Academia Chapter #430
In My Hero Academia's final databook, Kohei Horikoshi himself confirms that his new hero armor replicates the abilities of One For All . According to Kohei Horikoshi, this hero armor was made with careful consideration of Deku's fighting style and all his capabilities. In other words, the abilities that Deku once wielded can be replicated with this new armor.
Furthermore, on top of producing these abilities, Deku's hero armor also gives him the ability to combine two different powers together, just as he did with his Vestige Quirks. For instance, Deku could use Fa Jin and Black Whip at the same time. He can do that with his new hero suit as well. Deku can also use Black Whip and Float at the same time, and his hero suit allows him to do this as well.
Question: How does the armor that Deku received from Class A function?
Horikoshi: It tries to mimic various OFA abilities; for example, it has cable extensions that function like his ability, Black Whip. It also serves as a prototype where he can try to combine various abilities.
— Kohei Horikoshi confirms the return of One For All via Deku's new armor, Ultra Age
Unfortunately, the full capabilities of this hero armor suit remain to be seen, but hopefully, we will get a proper look at it soon when My Hero Academia makes a brief return at Jump Festa 2027 on December 19 . Regardless, if Deku's hero armor fully replicates the One For All, as Kohei Horikoshi states, then it goes without saying that he is the strongest new Pro Hero in the current era.
The fact that he was able to rise to Number 4 hero within a couple of months, despite not having any quirk, further backs up the fact that his overall combat power is on a completely different level. It must also be noted that he is above Katsuki Bakugo in terms of overall rankings, which also supports the fact that he is the strongest right now.

The best part about Deku's new hero armor is that he will continue to gain new powers over time, unlike those with Quirks. A Quirk user can improve upon their abilities to a certain degree, after which they peak, but technology is very different. With more time, technology keeps getting more advanced, and that means Deku's armor is going to continue to receive newer updates. If 8 years were enough to grant Deku such advanced armor, in the next decade, Deku's hero armor will be on a completely different level. This would go on to make him the strongest Hero of all time, surpassing even the likes of All Might and his own self from the Final War arc.
Furthermore, it must also be noted that the rise in technology will also give rise to powerful villains in the world of My Hero Academia. Deku is not the only one who can utilize powerful armor. There are bound to be some others in the My Hero Academia world who can get their hands on strong and powerful armor and utilize them for terror. In the absence of All For One and Shigaraki, someone has to step up as the next threat, especially if My Hero Academia continues in December 2026.
All things considered, both the heroes and the villains in the world of My Hero Academia are likely to grow stronger and more dangerous with this new technology, and we are eagerly waiting to see what results it brings. My Hero Academia has a big announcement planned for Jump Festa 2027, where it is holding its own stage as part of the Super Stage Red on December 19, 2026. Hopefully, this announcement pertains to the return of the manga or a continuation through a movie . In either case, we are hoping to see Izuku Midoriya fight as a Pro Hero with his new armor soon enough, and hopefully Horikoshi delivers.
All the chapters of My Hero Academia are available for fans to read via Manga Plus and Viz Media .
